description: Achats : Bulletins des prévisions de marchés de consultations SNCF Réseau – Horizon 3 à 5 ans (PréviWeb) is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Une mise à jour du jeu de données a été effectuée au cours du mois de octobre 2025. La Direction des Achats Réseau (DAR) de SNCF Réseau publie ses données prévisionnelles de consultations sur 3 à 5 ans. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Achats. Its keywords are Marchés, consultations, Famille de travaux, prestations. The portal shows 2026-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
